Step Range: 0-2
The Oracle: Willi Forst (German version) / Anthony Asquith (English version)
Evidence: WebSurfer identifies the film as "Leise flehen meine Lieder" (1933) directed by Willi Forst, and also notes the English release "Unfinished Symphony" directed by Anthony Asquith.

The Subtask Name: Determine the birthplace of the director associated with the English-language release
Step Range: 3-21
The Oracle: London, England (United Kingdom)
